question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Sree did not go to work today, as she was __feeling a bit under the weather__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. "feeling ill".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"under the weather"** is an idiom that means feeling slightly unwell or ill. (बीमार महसूस करना)

 
 
• **Example:** After staying out in the rain for hours, I felt a bit under the weather the next day.
 
 
 
• The correct substitution for the underlined part in the sentence is **"feeling ill"**, which means experiencing sickness or not feeling well. (अस्वस्थ महसूस करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She didn't attend the meeting because she was feeling ill after eating something bad.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Feeling nervous** (घबराहट महसूस करना): A state of being anxious or worried about something.

 
 
• **Example:** He was feeling nervous before giving his first public speech.
 
 
 
• **Feeling tired** (थकावट महसूस करना): A state of being exhausted or lacking energy.
 
 
• **Example:** After working all day, she was feeling tired and wanted to rest.
 
 
 
• **Feeling excited** (उत्साहित महसूस करना): A state of being very happy, enthusiastic, or eager about something.
 
 
• **Example:** The children were feeling excited about their upcoming school trip.
